neighboring_unit_entries.title: Dilation turns the base extremizer into the bandwidth-Delta minorant
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Defining the final minorant by dilating the Carneiro-Vaaler function and adding the offset transports pointwise minorization, doubles the exponential-type scale to the requested bandwidth, rescales the Fourier transform, and assembles the three proposition clauses from the preceding estimates.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: A nonoptimal convolution minorant sacrifices sharpness for a wider kernel class
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: An integral kernel with compactly supported Fourier transform is assembled into another minorant. The authors identify it with the construction underlying the earlier proposition, explicitly note that it is not optimal, and emphasize that it applies to related shifted logarithmic kernels outside the Carneiro-Vaaler framework. This exposes a sharpness-versus-generality tradeoff.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Once the extremal minorant sharpens the zero-side approximation, estimating the resulting prime sum becomes the stated barrier to better pointwise bounds, while studying how often it is large can still support moment analysis.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The paper identifies the barrier in this method; it does not prove that no other method can improve the bound.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Analytic approximation gain exposes an arithmetic bottleneck

spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: After optimizing the analytic surrogate, the obstruction moves rather than disappears: the remaining prime Dirichlet sum is hard to control pointwise. The same object can still be useful distributionally, because the frequency with which it becomes large informs moment estimates.

directed.source_grounded_mathematics: The discussion compares estimate (5) with an earlier bound expressing log|ζ(1/2+it)| through a truncated von Mangoldt weighted sum and logarithmic error terms. It states that good estimates for this prime sum at large t are difficult and block better pointwise zeta bounds, while information about how often such sums are large can be used to study moments of ζ.
directed.conceptual_reading: Improving one component of a proof pipeline exposes the next bottleneck. When worst-case pointwise control is inaccessible, reframing the same arithmetic statistic distributionally changes the attainable target from maxima to moments.
directed.representation_or_bridge: The bandlimited minorant transfers the original zero-side problem into a prime polynomial; frequency-of-large-values information then bridges that prime statistic to moment questions.
directed.boundary_or_failure: The barrier is asserted for this method and prime-sum representation, not as a theorem excluding other approaches. Moment information does not by itself yield the desired pointwise bound.
directed.uncertainty: The obstruction and workaround are clear in prose, but the earlier displayed inequality, constants, and admissible parameter threshold are formula-risk and need scan verification.
